rationale: Houthis tighten Red Sea grip and Israel destroys Hezbollah base continue regional escalation affecting EU energy and shipping; train derailment in France is a nearby EU incident but no direct Polish impact.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize Perim island Red Sea route
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis capture strategic Perim island on major shipping lane, tightening control over Bab al-Mandab Strait and threatening EU supply routes and energy costs.

top_events.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
top_events.label: Israel destroys Hezbollah underground base Lebanon
top_events.summary: Massive blast equivalent to magnitude 4.1 earthquake destroys major Hezbollah base in Lebanon, continuing Middle East escalation with indirect energy market risk for Poland.

top_events.title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
top_events.label: France train derails 44 injured Normandy
top_events.summary: Train operating Rouen-Caen route in Normandy derails with 180 passengers aboard, injuring 44. Nearby EU incident but no direct impact on Polish daily life.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea shipping

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening Red Sea shipping
most_significant_event.summary: Capture of Mokha brings Houthis closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a critical waterway for EU trade and energy imports affecting Poland's supply chains.
most_significant_event.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
